nodes.description: A live sensor/derived stream selected from the broker. Emits its records downstream; the port descriptor is the stream's own.
nodes.label: Stream source

nodes.description: Absolute-value mapping over a numeric channel frame
nodes.label: Rectify

nodes.description: Pure low-pass smoothing stage for numeric channel frames without implicit rectification
nodes.label: Low-pass envelope

nodes.description: Pure band-pass IIR filter using cascaded high-pass and low-pass stages
nodes.label: Band-pass IIR

nodes.description: Narrowband notch filtering with optional harmonic sections up to Nyquist
nodes.label: Notch IIR

nodes.description: Sliding RMS magnitude estimate over a fixed number of samples with prefix-window startup behavior
nodes.label: RMS window

nodes.description: Explicit overlapping sample windows emitted as derived channel frames
nodes.label: Sliding window

nodes.description: Pure high-pass IIR filter with Butterworth or biquad design options
nodes.label: High-pass IIR

nodes.description: Reduces one windowed channel frame (e.g. from Sliding window) to its mean absolute value per channel
nodes.label: Mean Absolute Value

nodes.description: Reduces one windowed channel frame (e.g. from Sliding window) to its root-mean-square value per channel — unlike RMS window, this is a one-shot per-window reduction, not a continuous moving filter
nodes.label: RMS (windowed)

nodes.description: Reduces one windowed channel frame to the cumulative absolute difference between consecutive samples per channel
nodes.label: Waveform Length

nodes.description: Counts zero-crossings per channel within one windowed channel frame, ignoring crossings below the threshold
nodes.label: Zero Crossings

nodes.description: Counts slope-sign changes per channel within one windowed channel frame, ignoring changes below the threshold
nodes.label: Slope Sign Changes

nodes.description: Fits a Levinson-Durbin autoregressive model to one windowed channel frame, emitting ar_order coefficients per channel
nodes.label: AR Coefficients

nodes.description: Scores a flat feature-vector frame (e.g. from a Combine node) against a diagonal-covariance LDA model loaded from disk, emitting a predicted class index and per-class confidences
nodes.label: LDA Classify

nodes.description: Self-contained EMG gesture classifier: consumes raw EMG frames and internally reproduces the training pipeline (sliding window -> DSP -> Hudgins features -> rest-calibration normalization -> LDA), driven entirely by a model bundle so live accuracy matches training. Point model_path at the emg-gesture-bundle.json written by the train node.
nodes.label: EMG Gesture Classify

nodes.description: Passes through a subset of a multi-channel frame's channels — e.g. destructure a concatenated feature vector into per-family or per-source sub-vectors. Keep every channel, channels whose label contains a substring, or an explicit index range/list.
nodes.label: Select / Split channels

nodes.description: Fans in two or more upstream channel frames into one flattened feature-vector frame (e.g. several feature extractors into a model input).
nodes.label: Combine

nodes.description: Renders the upstream node's output live on the canvas. The renderer is chosen from the output descriptor's capabilities.
nodes.label: Viewer

nodes.description: Terminal node that consumes its upstream output (e.g. records it).
nodes.label: Sink

nodes.description: A source of timestamped markers: runs a structured protocol (ordered cues + labels) and emits a `markers` stream (cue/session events) that marker-aware nodes downstream can render or train on. Has no inputs — the cue timeline is generated independently of any data source.
nodes.label: Experiment

nodes.description: Trains a classifier on a recorded session dataset (model families + feature windowing), producing a durable model artifact a classify node can load. Wire an experiment into it to scope the training runs, and its models output into a classify node to serve them.
nodes.label: Train
